status: CONFIRMED (pricing + caps extracted; backend API NOT CONFIRMED - robots-blocked)
key_findings: MLB player-prop analytics product (PropIQ Inc) on Next.js + SvelteKit-style immutable chunks, hosted on Vercel. iOS app on App Store; one web subscription (CA$17.99/mo or CA$189.99/yr) covers web+iPhone. Product: every MLB player prop with L5/L10/L20 game-log hit rates, de-vigged market edge, 0-100 Confidence Score, 7 game markets incl NRFI/F5, model builder, arb scanner, phone-synced bet tracking; built on game logs + Statcast data. Most restrictive cap: EVERYTHING gated behind the single subscription - no free tier advertised; robots disallows /api/, /auth/, /models, /arbs, /account, /subscribe (private app surface). 727-url sitemap exposes per-player MLB pages (public SEO layer).
